newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian retail matches forecast - Howard.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian retail matches forecast - Howard.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Wednesday that latest retail trade figures were consistent with forecasts in the government's mid-year budget review.

"The mid-term review indicated very strongly that amongst the changes had been a greater shift towards business investment and some downward revision in private consumption, and in that sense, those retail sales figures were consistent with that," Howard told parliament.
Figures released on Tuesday showed Australian retail sales fell 1.0 percent in December and dropped 1.3 percent in real terms over the December quarter.
Market forecasts had centred on a 0.5 percent rise in the monthly data and a 0.5 percent fall in quarterly real terms.
In its mid-year budget review released on January 28, the government revised its 1996/97 business investment forecast upwards to 17 percent from its August forecast of 14 percent.
It revised its private consumption forecast for the 1996/97 year down to 2.5 percent from 3.0 percent previously.
